Unit Tests: Taste Spoons

Robots check known answers. Green = safe to refactor.

⏱ 16 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

add(2,3) MUST taste 5

@Test writes the spoon.

🥄

Taste spoon. @Test + assertEquals(expected, actual) sips. Red spoon → fix the RECIPE, never blame the spoon (editing tests to match bugs = shooting the messenger).

Recipe + spoons
// Calculator.java: the recipe
static int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
// CalculatorTest.java: the spoons
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
class CalculatorTest {
  @Test void adds() { assertEquals(5, add(2, 3)); }
  @Test void zeroEdge() { assertEquals(3, add(3, 0)); }
  @Test void negatives() { assertEquals(0, add(-2, 2)); }
}
Edges, not just sunshine: 0, negatives, empties. Bugs breed at boundaries; middles behave.
